name: LanPaint inner early stop
plain: Ends the inner relaxation of one outer step once the predicted image inside the mask stops changing. It watches the unknown area and a one-pixel ring next to the kept area, and also checks that many small changes have not added up to a large drift. Off by default: the nodes set the threshold to 0.0.
math:
dist=max(MSE_w(x̂₀ⁱ,x̂₀ⁱ⁻¹;inpaint), MSE_w(x̂₀ⁱ,x̂₀ⁱ⁻¹;ring)); ring=unknown pixels with a 4-neighbour known pixel.
If dist≤thr: anchor x̂₀ (first time), then dist=max(dist, drift from anchor). Else anchor cleared.
patience_counter counts passes, resets on a miss; stop when counter≥patience_eff.
threshold_eff and patience_eff are set in from_options using _abt_scale=4·abt(1−abt), which is 0 at the extremes and 1 mid-schedule. A custom distance hook replaces the metric and uses the raw threshold.
